Constructors

NumberToken(string, int)

Represents a token that contains a numeric value, parsed from a source string.

public NumberToken(string value, int startIndex)

Parameters

value string

The string representation of the numeric value. Must be a valid integer or floating-point number.

startIndex int

The starting index of the token in the source string.

Remarks

The numeric value is parsed into both integer and floating-point representations, if possible. The IsInt property indicates whether the value is an integer.

Gets or sets a value indicating whether the current value is an integer.
